verdict.rationale: CIPO's own site links an 'Integrated circuit topography registration, fees and forms' page and a page on how to pay patent maintenance fees. So fee information is published on the office's own pages rather than behind a contact form, but no actual fee amounts appear in the evidence, and the fee page shown covers only a niche transaction type. Missing for 10: actual published fee amounts, fee schedules for trademark/patent/design/copyright filings, and independent confirmation that exact statutory amounts are listed.
